TC-21/S27.title: Unsaved pre-round text survives a context switch and never appears in the other context
TC-21/S27.detail: Local 25acd727. 'MARK-H draft T21' typed in the Hospital pre-round editor, editor closed without Save Note, back to the list, switch to Nursing Home, resident chart, back to Hospital. 2/2 judged: the resident chart never shows the draft; the Hospital chart still shows it. Recorded: it survives because the editor autosaves (rounding:update with preRoundNotes / preRoundEditedAt when the editor closes), so the text is on the server, not only in the page.
